gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-liter: Commanding in a vintage way, Woodgod towers up top with lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals. Liter follows in sans-serif, drawn with a constant nib width like a drafting pen, and its wide-mouthed round forms keep paragraphs easy to travel.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-matangi: Vintage muscle meets twine-thin lines here. Woodgod carries the weight with wide channels cut into every bowl, and Matangi adds rounded, open letters drawn like wire, hefty in the lowercase.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-michroma: Woodgod's wide channel cut into every bowl gives the heading a vintage, carved look, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. And Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, so its tall-bodied lowercase spreads out across the page.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-miriam-libre: Cast-iron stature, vintage and bossy. Woodgod leads with tall lowercase, and Miriam Libre follows in sans-serif with wire-drawn strokes and an open s, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-montserrat-underli: Montserrat Underline draws its round bowls in flat, single-weight line, with lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Woodgod's vintage heading sits above it, and long stretches read without any bumps.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, a friendly contemporary face under a commanding heading. Woodgod's vintage, channel-cut letters are the real draw.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Woodgod's wide channel cut into every bowl gives it a commanding, vintage voice. Noto Sans Adlam sits beneath it with curve endings held well apart, so its tall, full lowercase gives the heading plenty of breathing space.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Vintage and commanding, with swagger. Woodgod tops the page in tall lowercase, while Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits below with generous space between curve ends and stems, keeping cases close in height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Wide channels cut into every bowl mark Woodgod as vintage and commanding. Noto Sans Armenian is the roomier partner, with tall, full lowercase c, s and z and round letters that open wide.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Woodgod cuts a wide channel into every bowl, which gives its tall lowercase a vintage, commanding look that nearly matches its capitals. Noto Sans Bamum then reads easily, with big open counters in every small letter.
